blocks.example: No way! That's so weird. **When did you last see him?**

blocks.instr: Complete the chat and say the words. Tap the yellow to check.
blocks.tip: Here comes the text from our lesson, with the first letters. 🔖 = "we didn't know this" — Olya sees which gaps were hard.

p: I know! I saw the empty bowl this morning. It's so weird,
. The bowl's still here, but no Gary.
UPDATE: found him. Ken took him home for the weekend and forgot to bring him back. He said Gary looked lonely.

cards.why: С since — «с тех пор и до сих пор»: has been missing.

blocks.instr: How do you say it in English?

blocks.tip: Tap a phrase in the box when you say it — it turns green. ⬅ Board takes you back to the game.
items: Tell your partner about a time something went missing at work or at home (real or made up!). What was it? Did it turn up? Your partner reacts and asks **two** questions.
blocks.fast: If you're done: act out Mia and Sam's chat from memory.
